contributor to MP

She published in MP \'Mr Valentine\' and \'Christian\'s Name\' as \'Joanna Harrison\', under which name also appeared a novel, A Northern Lily (1886). She lived at St. Andrew\'s, and perhaps was Harriette Cheape, elder daughter of Alexander Cheape (1803-1892), of Strathyrum, St. Andrews, Fife, or his younger daughter Jean Anne.
